Our Solutions

Solutions

Enterprise solutions spanning SAP S/4HANA, cloud platform, OKR, HCM, and cyber security — built around Excelligent's SAP-centric delivery approach.

Excelligent Consulting Services is an IT service company formed by industry veterans with a view to make the implementation journey of Enterprise Level Applications like ERP, HRMS, PMS, and CRM a rewarding experience for customers. Most of Excelligent's customers are SAP ECC and S/4HANA customers who wish to use SAP ERP to its fullest potential.

SAP Enterprise Platform

GROW with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud

GROW with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud is a comprehensive offering by SAP aimed at facilitating the digital transformation journey of businesses. It combines the power of SAP S/4HANA, SAP's flagship intelligent ERP system, with the flexibility and scalability of cloud computing. Unlike traditional on-premises installations, the Public Cloud deployment model means the software is hosted and managed by SAP in the cloud, allowing for easier scalability, reduced infrastructure overhead, and faster deployment of updates and new features.

RISE with SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud

RISE with SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud is a comprehensive offering from SAP that provides businesses with a pathway to transition their existing ERP systems to a cloud environment. Customers can move to cloud ERP at their own pace to safeguard existing SAP ERP investments, driving innovation and unlocking new efficiencies with intelligent automation. It is designed to help businesses of various sizes and industries transition to a modern, cloud-based ERP system with a tailored approach that meets their unique needs, ensuring a secure, compliant, and efficient operational environment.

SAP BTP

SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP) is an integrated offering from SAP that brings together database and data management, application development and integration, analytics, and intelligent technologies to help businesses innovate, integrate, and scale efficiently, supporting their digital transformation journey with a robust, flexible technology foundation.

People & Performance

End-to-end HR activities and improved contingent-workforce management via the People Choice human capital management platform — simplifying complex HR tasks for both the workforce and HR teams, including multi-country payroll, so they can focus on what matters most.
